slug: Jay & Sherry: The Mountain of Shadows
tagline: An Adventure Story for Kids Ages 5-9 About Bravery, Friendship, and Kindness
title: Jay & Sherry: The Mountain of Shadows
description:
One brave boy, one loyal dog, and one mysterious mountain. Jay and his best friend Sherry go on an adventure beyond the village and up the Mountain of Shadows, where dark clouds hide a secret, strange creatures roam the rocks at night, and a frightened village needs their help.

When they discover the truth behind the Shadow Demons, Jay learns that true courage is not about never being afraid—it is about helping others even when afraid. With teamwork, kindness, and one clever dog, they uncover a secret that could turn enemies into friends.

The book is described as teaching:
- Bravery: facing fears one step at a time
- Kindness: understanding people before judging them
- Friendship and teamwork: working together to solve problems
- Empathy: recognizing that enemies may be scared rather than evil

Other listed features:
- 30 illustrated, full-color adventure pages
- A boy-and-dog hero duo
- Fantasy creatures described as exciting but not scary
- A heartwarming ending with a gentle moral
- Suitable for bedtime reading, early readers, and home or classroom storytime
